subject: Roadmap QBR — scheduling + exec availability for renewal/expansion

Hi Soojin and Laura,

Hope you're both well. We're kicking off renewal planning for Q1 and want to combine a roadmap review + expansion conversation into a single QBR so execs can see the value and decide on next steps.

High-level ask: can we lock a 60–90 minute slot in the week of Dec 20 to:
- review usage and cost trends
- walk through the roadmap items relevant to our expansion (batch inference, private deployment)
- align on procurement/contract timing

Constraints: our CEO and Head of Ops are only available for short windows that week — ideally mornings PT, but they have a dense calendar. If you have a couple of options (and a fallback host from your side), that would help a lot.

Thanks — I can loop in James from procurement if we need formal timelines.

Best,
Claire Morris
Head of Product, HealthBridge
claire@healthbridge.com

P.S. we may need a short technical run-through for our infra team afterwards (30m).

1) Tue, Dec 21 — 10:00–11:30 (90 min)
2) Wed, Dec 22 — 14:00–15:30 (90 min)

If you need shorter, we're flexible to compress to 60 minutes and follow up with a technical deep-dive recording for your infra team. Ben will lead the technical portion if needed; Laura will run the renewal ops and procurement ask.

I've attached a draft agenda (QBR-Agenda-HealthBridge.pdf) — let me know which option works and who'll be on the call from your side. If execs prefer mornings only, flag that and we'll reprioritize.
